text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills slipped to 49.98 percent from 55.21 percent at the last sale on October 8, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Thursday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 20.00 million UAH 40.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 17.78 million UAH 35.16 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 200,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 1,125 were competitive and 198,875 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for October 15.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills slipped to 59.53 percent from 59.57 percent at the last sale on October 8, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 15.67 million UAH 8.73 million UAH
Actual amount raised 12.08 million UAH 6.73 million UAH
The central bank sold 156,730 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 111,741 were competitive and 44,989 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 15.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills edged down to 61.46 percent against 62.75 percent at the last sale on October 8, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 2,489 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 2,000 were competitive and 489 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 15. --Kiev newsroom +380 44 229-2264
